punchline: On Salatin's farm, what the cows leave behind is the hens' job, and what the hens leave is the sheep's.
thirty_sec: Joel Salatin lines his animals up in order on his Virginia farm. When the cattle finish a pasture, a portable coop of several hundred laying hens moves in, picks larvae out of the manure and scatters it. Sheep come later for the new growth and weeds. In winter the manure is piled with straw and corn, and the pigs root through it in spring. Michael Pollan described that sequence.
